'''Kindra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] student during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] who trained at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith Academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]].

==Biography==
After the outbreak of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Sickness]] at the Academy, Kindra teamed up with fellow students [[Hartwig]], [[Maggs]] and [[Mnah Ra'at]] and the Sith Combat Master [[Xat Hracken]]. However, Hracken, Hartwig and Ra'at died, leaving only Maggs and Kindra. The girl then severed Maggs' Achilles tendons with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], immobilizing him and leaving him to [[Death/Legends|die]]. On her way back to the [[Darth Scabrous's tower|tower]], Kindra was captured by the [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] students. The zombies forced her to contact the mechanic [[Pergus Frode]] and tell him to open the hatch to the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] he was hiding in. Once it was open, Kindra tried to break free but was devoured.

==Personality and traits==
Kindra was very self centered, not caring about the fate of others proven by when she left Maggs to die. This could be explained by the fact that she was a Sith student and was encouraged to behave as such.
